meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 可以联网:用 Exa 按语义搜索网页、查研究资料,也能抓取指定 URL 的网页、文章和学术 PDF,一次可批量处理多个链接。搜索时还能用 research paper 类别和学术域名白名单偏向论文来源。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索、查找资料,或提供网址让它读取、提取正文时触发;做科学或技术类研究查询时也会走它。

say.text: 搜索最近关于 mRNA 疫苗稳定性的论文
say.note: 调用 Exa 搜索,偏向学术来源

say.text: 抓取 https://arxiv.org/abs/xxxx 这篇论文的内容
批量提取这三个链接的内容

howto.what_en: With Exa installed, Claude can search the web and fetch URL content: look up topics or research, extract webpages, articles and academic PDFs, and batch multiple URLs at once. Search can be filtered toward papers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search the web, look something up, fetch a page, or extract an article, or supply a URL to read.

say_en.text: Search recent papers on mRNA vaccine stability
say_en.note: Runs an Exa search biased toward scholarly sources.
Handles multiple links in one call.
